title: inula serratuloides
intro: Inula serratuloides, commonly known as Asteraceae family member, is a type of flowering plant. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Inula serratuloides may involve its ability to reduce inflammation, improve immune function, and exhibit antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
